Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.

name: "MiNiFi-CPP CI"
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * 1'
concurrency:
  group: >-
    ${{ github.workflow }}-
    ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}-
    ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}-
    ${{ github.repository == 'apache/nifi-minifi-cpp' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' && github.run_id || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}
env:
  CCACHE_DIR: ${{ GITHUB.WORKSPACE }}/.ccache
  CONAN_LOGIN_USERNAME_NIFI_CONAN: ${{ secrets.CONAN_USERNAME }}
  CONAN_PASSWORD_NIFI_CONAN: ${{ secrets.CONAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
  DOCKER_CMAKE_FLAGS: -DDOCKER_VERIFY_THREADS=3 -DUSE_SHARED_LIBS= -DSTRICT_GSL_CHECKS=AUDIT -DCI_BUILD=ON -DENABLE_AWS=ON -DENABLE_KAFKA=ON -DENABLE_MQTT=ON -DENABLE_AZURE=ON -DENABLE_SQL=ON \
    -DENABLE_SPLUNK=ON -DENABLE_GCP=ON -DENABLE_OPC=ON -DENABLE_PYTHON_SCRIPTING=ON -DENABLE_LUA_SCRIPTING=ON -DENABLE_KUBERNETES=ON -DENABLE_TEST_PROCESSORS=ON -DENABLE_PROMETHEUS=ON \
    -DENABLE_ELASTICSEARCH=ON -DENABLE_GRAFANA_LOKI=ON -DENABLE_COUCHBASE=ON -DENABLE_LLAMACPP=ON -DMINIFI_LMDB=ON -DDOCKER_BUILD_ONLY=ON -DMINIFI_PERFORMANCE_TESTS=ON -DMINIFI_RUST=ON \
    -DENABLE_BUSTACHE=ON -DENABLE_SFTP=ON -DENABLE_EXECUTE_PROCESS=ON -DDOCKER_USE_CONAN=ON -DDOCKER_NIFI_CONAN_USER=${{ secrets.CONAN_USERNAME }} -DDOCKER_NIFI_CONAN_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.CONAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
jobs:
  macos_xcode:
    name: "macOS 26 aarch64"
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'push' ||
      github.repository != 'apache/nifi-minifi-cpp' ||
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      MACOS_MINIFI_OPTIONS: >-
        -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        -DCI_BUILD=ON
        -DCUSTOM_MALLOC=OFF
        -DDOCKER_BUILD_ONLY=OFF
        -DDOCKER_PUSH=OFF
        -DDOCKER_SKIP_TESTS=ON
        -DENABLE_ALL=OFF
        -DENABLE_AWS=ON
        -DENABLE_AZURE=ON
        -DENABLE_BUSTACHE=OFF
        -DENABLE_BZIP2=ON
        -DENABLE_CIVET=ON
        -DENABLE_CONTROLLER=ON
        -DENABLE_COUCHBASE=ON
        -DENABLE_ELASTICSEARCH=ON
        -DENABLE_ENCRYPT_CONFIG=ON
        -DENABLE_GCP=ON
        -DENABLE_KUBERNETES=ON
        -DENABLE_LIBARCHIVE=ON
        -DENABLE_LLAMACPP=ON
        -DENABLE_KAFKA=ON
        -DENABLE_LUA_SCRIPTING=ON
        -DENABLE_LZMA=ON
        -DENABLE_MQTT=ON
        -DENABLE_OPC=ON
        -DENABLE_OPS=ON
        -DENABLE_PROMETHEUS=ON
        -DENABLE_PYTHON_SCRIPTING=ON
        -DENABLE_ROCKSDB=ON
        -DENABLE_SFTP=ON
        -DENABLE_SPLUNK=ON
        -DENABLE_SQL=ON
        -DMINIFI_RUST=ON
        -DENABLE_TEST_PROCESSORS=ON
        -DMINIFI_LMDB=ON
        -DFORCE_COLORED_OUTPUT=OFF
        -DLIBC_STATIC=OFF
        -DMINIFI_ADVANCED_ASAN_BUILD=OFF
        -DMINIFI_ADVANCED_CODE_COVERAGE=OFF
        -DMINIFI_FAIL_ON_WARNINGS=OFF
        -DMINIFI_USE_REAL_ODBC_TEST_DRIVER=ON
        -DPORTABLE=ON
        -DSKIP_TESTS=OFF
        -DUSE_SHARED_LIBS=ON
        -DMINIFI_PERFORMANCE_TESTS=ON
        -DUSE_CONAN=ON
    steps:
      - id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: cache restore
        uses: action

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
trigger CI for each submitted revision


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
omit a revision only under an approved skip policy


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/after.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-trigger CI for each submitted revision
+omit a revision only under an approved skip policy
contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute
preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted
